findings.evidence: Mathlib/Topology/Algebra/Nonarchimedean/Basic.lean:122 `theorem left_mul_subset (U : OpenAddSubgroup R) (r : R) : ∃ V : OpenAddSubgroup R, r • (V : Set R) ⊆ U`; Mathlib/Topology/Algebra/OpenSubgroup.lean:245 `theorem isOpen_of_mem_nhds [SeparatelyContinuousMul G] (H : Subgroup G) {g : G} (hg : (H : Set G) ∈ 𝓝 g) : IsOpen (H : Set G)` (`@[to_additive]`, so `AddSubgroup.isOpen_of_mem_nhds` exists). `NonarchimedeanRing` extends `IsTopologicalRing` (Basic.lean:49), so the continuity side conditions are available.
findings.fix: Replace the proof body with `obtain ⟨Z, hZ⟩ := NonarchimedeanRing.left_mul_subset ⟨V, V.isOpen_of_mem_nhds hV⟩ a; exact ⟨Z, fun z hz ↦ hZ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩⟩` (`a • (Z : Set A) ⊆ V` unfolds to `a * z ∈ V` via `smul_eq_mul`).
findings.issue: `exists_openAddSubgroup_mul_subset` re-proves Mathlib's `NonarchimedeanRing.left_mul_subset` from scratch (continuity of `fun x ↦ a * x` plus `NonarchimedeanAddGroup.is_nonarchimedean`). The only difference is that the target is an `AddSubgroup` that is a neighbourhood of zero rather than a bundled `OpenAddSubgroup`, and such a subgroup is open by `AddSubgroup.isOpen_of_mem_nhds`.

findings.evidence: Mathlib/Algebra/Ring/Subsemiring/Basic.lean:725 `def codRestrict (f : R →+* S) (s : σS) (h : ∀ x, f x ∈ s) : R →+* s`, with `@[simp] codRestrict_apply` at line 729. `MvPowerSeries.C : R →+* MvPowerSeries σ R` at Mathlib/RingTheory/MvPowerSeries/Basic.lean:334, and `isWeightedRestricted_C T a : IsWeightedRestricted T (MvPowerSeries.C a)` is the membership proof (carrier is `{f | IsWeightedRestricted T f}`).
findings.fix: `noncomputable def weightedC ... : A →+* weightedRestrictedSubring T hT := (MvPowerSeries.C : A →+* MvPowerSeries (Fin k) A).codRestrict _ (isWeightedRestricted_C T)`. `coe_weightedC` then holds by `RingHom.codRestrict_apply` (still `rfl`), and `weightedRestrictedSubring.instAlgebra`/`coe_algebraMap_weightedRestrictedSubring` are unchanged.
findings.issue: `weightedC` assembles a `RingHom` into the subring by hand, discharging `map_one'`, `map_mul'`, `map_zero'`, `map_add'` with four `by ext; simp` proofs. `RingHom.codRestrict` is the library combinator that does exactly this assembly for a ring hom whose image lands in a subsemiring/subring.

summary: Two located Mathlib declarations are re-derived here: NonarchimedeanRing.left_mul_subset and RingHom.codRestrict. The prior round's finding against the `_def`/`_iff` unfolding lemmas is withdrawn — the bodies are genuinely unexposed under `public section` without `@[expose]`, matching the precedent in RestrictedPowerSeries.lean.
